Class AsiKart

java.lang.Object
com.jme3.app.LegacyApplication
com.jme3.app.SimpleApplication
uno.anahata.asi.yam.games.asikart.AsiKart
All Implemented Interfaces:
com.jme3.app.Application, com.jme3.input.controls.ActionListener, com.jme3.input.controls.InputListener, com.jme3.system.SystemListener, ItemManager.ItemPickupListener
public class AsiKart extends com.jme3.app.SimpleApplication implements com.jme3.input.controls.ActionListener, ItemManager.ItemPickupListener
AsiKart 3D v4.2 — Console-Grade Arcade Kart Racer.

Features a clean, modular multi-class architecture:

  • TrackBuilder — Multi-circuit 3D world generator (Rainbow Circuit, Desert Speedway, Cyber Circuit).
  • ItemManager — Stationary 3D Item Mystery Boxes, 3D Upright Gold Coins, Green/Red Shells, and Bananas.
  • AudioManager — Spatial audio and sound feedback chimes.

Includes 3-Tier Mini-Turbo Drift Sparks, Interactive Radar Minimap, Directional Corner Arrow Warning Signs, real-time directional shadow maps, PBR asphalt normal/bump surface textures, and 3D Sky Domes.

Since:
1.1.0-SNAPSHOT
Author:
anahata
